method: Each row below was read first-hand from the cited official page during this session with the agent fetch tool. Nothing was inferred from a previous session's notes. Where the page could not be read (cookie wall, client-rendered table, redirect to a different competition) the verdict is 'unreadable' and no claim is made.

verdict_key.confirmed: the published value was read back from the official page exactly as published
verdict_key.partially_confirmed: some published values were read back, other values on the same row were not visible
verdict_key.contradicted: the official page shows something incompatible with the published row
verdict_key.unreadable: the page could not be read in this session, so the row stays unverified
